h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Aurangabad

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Aurangabad

c: Aurangabad, now officially Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, has large industrial areas at Waluj, Chikalthana and Shendra. Many companies there want an outdoor gym for staff. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Aurangabad to these corporate campuses, as well as to schools, colleges, housing societies and municipal gardens. We make the Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 260 km away, and install them by road with our own team.

A corporate open gym has a different job from a park. It has to look neat beside an office block, take short sessions during breaks and need almost no supervision. Body-weight machines do this well. Choose a colour scheme that matches your campus, since we offer 15+ roto-moulded colour shades. Aurangabad is on the Deccan plateau, with hot summers, moderate rain and fairly hard ground, which suits grouted installation. Send us a site plan and we will show where each machine goes.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms to companies in Waluj or Shendra MIDC?
items.a: Yes. Share the space and photos of your campus. We send a layout drawing and quote, manufacture at our Vasai factory and install with our team.

items.a: Yes, within our 15+ roto-moulded colour shades. Tell us your colours when you share the site details and we will suggest the closest match.
